_help: Curated calendar entries for the home page. md = MM-DD, y = year of the original event/birth (drives the "Nth anniversary" text; omit for yearly observances). cat = birthday | history | science. noClass = dated closures: {"from":"2026-11-23","to":"2026-11-27","label":"Thanksgiving break"} marks Mon/Wed/Fri class days inside the range as no class. Holidays, Easter, feasts, solstices and equinoxes are computed in assets/js/home-calendar.mjs.
